title: Nutty Crispy Canadian Chickpeas Hash
description: A sweet and crispy Canadian dish featuring chickpeas, perfect for brunch, made with a tadka and raw-friendly ingredients.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the maple syrup, olive oil, salt, cumin seeds, and coriander seeds.
Add the chickpeas, onion, and garlic to the bowl and stir until they are evenly coated with the syrup mixture.
Spread the chickpea mixture on a baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and stir in the chopped pecans.
Return the baking sheet to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the chickpeas are crispy.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and let the hash cool for a few minutes.
Serve the Nutty Crispy Canadian Chickpeas Hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
